input.needs_engineer_reason: Confirmed users should be able to sign in; this may be a regression in supabase-js 2.45.1.
input.summary: After confirming their email, the user cannot sign in with signInWithPassword and gets 'Invalid login credentials'. They expect sign-in to work once the email is confirmed.
input.draft_reply: Thanks for the report. 'Invalid login credentials' usually means the email/password pair does not match, while an unconfirmed email returns 'Email not confirmed' (see https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/passwords#signing-in-with-an-email-and-password). Could you share the auth logs for one failed attempt and confirm the project's email settings?
